description: This file defines the helper class DynamoDBGatewayListProviderHelper, which contains a static method to parse a data connection string and populate a DynamoDBGatewayOptions object with configuration values such as service, access key, secret key, read capacity units, and write capacity units.

classes.name: DynamoDBGatewayListProviderHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to parse connection string data for DynamoDB configuration.

methods.name: ParseDataConnectionString
methods.description: Parses a semicolon-separated data connection string to set properties on the provided DynamoDBGatewayOptions object.
